description: Review the current uncommitted changes: take the git diff, then an independent read-only reviewer checks correctness, regressions, risks and tests, and gives a verdict. Ревью текущих изменений (git diff), ничего не меняя.

nodes.instruction:
Review these changes. Focus: {{task}}
Look for bugs, regressions, unhandled errors, security problems, missing tests. Read the surrounding code where the diff alone is not enough. Do NOT modify files. Answer with the JSON object: verdict="approve" or "changes_requested", findings=<a short list: file:line — problem — suggested fix>.
